selected_evidence.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Created the CA and verified its exact subject, self-signed issuer, CA:TRUE constraint, signing usage, matching certificate/private-key public hashes, and secure permissions.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
selected_evidence.summary: Rebuilt the RHEL trust store; OpenSSL verification against the system bundle returned OK, and p11-kit listed the certificate as an authority trust anchor.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after configuration and restart, node1 remained RHEL 10.0 with running kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID changed to 9b97bfd2-42c6-4eb3-a07f-52e72ee81167. Post-restart system state was running, the certificate and key persisted with matching hashes and permissions, and system trust verification remained successful.

set -eu; install -d -m 700 /etc/pki/CA/private; tmpcert=/tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.pem.$$; umask 077; openssl req -new -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -keyout /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out "$tmpcert"; chmod 600 /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key; install -m 0644 "$tmpcert" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem; rm -f "$tmpcert"; printf 'CA_CREATED\n'

set -eu; cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem; key=/etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key; openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256; openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | grep -A2 -E 'Basic Constraints|Key Usage'; printf 'CERT_PUBLIC_KEY_SHA256='; openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; printf 'PRIVATE_PUBLIC_KEY_SHA256='; openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; stat -c 'MODE=%a OWNER=%U:%G PATH=%n' "$key" "$cert"; openssl verify -purpose any -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"
